subject: Private Offer: AWS Marketplace — 3yr Prepay Escalator & Ramp Structure
messages:
From: Brynna Cole <brynna@finovate.ai>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Hart <alex.hart@finovate.ai>, procurement@finovate.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: AWS private offer request — looking at 3yr prepay with ramp

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team loved the latency profile. Procurement asked me to formalize our ask so we can work with AWS marketplace. Our target: a 3-year prepaid commitment (annual invoices preferred) with an escalator/ramp so we don't need the full committed spend in year 1. Three items to confirm:

- Year 1: 35% of nominal annualized commit (to match our product ramp)
- Year 2: 65%
- Year 3: 100%

We'd like a tiered discount schedule tied to the multi-year commit: proposing 22% off list year 1, 25% year 2-3, plus a one-time onboarding credit applied against the first invoice. Can Redwood create an AWS private offer (PO) with those terms or point us to the standard escalator template?

Attaching the PO request form procurement prefers. Also looping in Alex (finance) and procurement email.

Appreciate your help — Brynna

Attachments: Finovate-AI_AWS_PO_Request.pdf

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: Brynna Cole <brynna@finovate.ai>
Cc: Alex Hart <alex.hart@finovate.ai>, procurement@finovate.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS private offer request — looking at 3yr prepay with ramp

Hi Brynna — great to hear the product resonated with the team.

We can absolutely get you an AWS Private Offer that supports an annual prepay with a ramp/escalator. A few quick clarifying notes so I can draft the PO and loop in our marketplace ops:

1) Discount cadence: are you asking for 22% off list applied to year 1 invoiced amount and 25% off list for years 2 and 3, or a blended effective discount over the 3 years?
2) Onboarding credit: confirm whether you want it as a dollar credit against the year 1 invoice or as a committed-service credit (reduces consumed units).
3) Payment timing: you said annual invoices — AWS requires the private offer to reflect the payment milestones. Do you want Redwood to bill AWS and receive an annual invoice from them, or have AWS bill you directly?

Internally I'll propose the following as an initial structure (subject to legal/marketplace ops):
- 3yr prepaid commitment, invoiced annually (yearly prepayments)
- Year 1 invoice = 35% of annualized committed value (discount applied to amount invoiced)
- Year 2 invoice = 65%
- Year 3 invoice = 100%
- Tiered discount: 22% applied to year 1, 25% to years 2-3 (we can also provide a blended table if Finance prefers)
- One-time onboarding credit: $40k credit applied to first invoice (appears as deduction on AWS invoice)

If that matches your ask, I'll draft the PO and send a redlineable doc. Also copying Monica on operational details (marketplace flows).

Best,
Camila Reyes
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: procurement@finovate.ai
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: Brynna Cole <brynna@finovate.ai>, Alex Hart <alex.hart@finovate.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS private offer request — looking at 3yr prepay with ramp

Camila,

Thanks — confirming: we want the discounts to be applied to the invoiced amounts each year (not a blended rate). The onboarding credit should be a line-item credit on Year 1 invoice. Also we need standard audit language around annual true-up and unused prepay handling (carry-forward vs. forfeiture). Can you provide Redwood's standard language?

Procurement team will need the draft PO and the AWS private offer JSON that we can attach to our AWS console for approvals. Ideally we receive the PO draft by next Tue (Nov 30).

Thanks,
Finovate Procurement

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: kathy_legal@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Finovate AWS PO — pricing/terms ask (internal)

Team — forwarding Finovate's request (see attachments). Key asks: 3yr annual prepay with ramp (35/65/100), per-year discounts (22%/25%), $40k onboarding credit, and explicit true-up/unused-prepay handling. They want PO draft by Tue Nov 30.

Proposal for approval:
- Approve year-level discounts as requested (22% / 25%) but cap onboarding credit at $40k and add a 12-month expiration for credit use.
- Unused prepay handling: allow 6-month carry-forward for unused credit; after that balance converts to AWS marketplace credit forfeiture unless a documented mutual extension is requested 30 days prior to year-end. This avoids indefinite liabilities on Redwood's side.
- Add a modest revenue protection clause: if consumption exceeds the nominal committed ramp by >30% in any year, Redwood reserves the right to invoice incremental usage at list less agreed discount for that billing period. This is to prevent uncontrolled over-consumption against the prepay model.

Can we fast-track legal on the AWS PO template and the private-offer JSON (ops needs the JSON to create the offer)? Monica/Karthik — any issues with the ramp percentages from a revenue recognition or marketplace standpoint?

Thanks,
Camila

From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: kathy_legal@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Finovate AWS PO — pricing/terms ask (internal)

Camila — quick notes:
- Accounting is fine with the ramp structure; we'll need the AWS invoice schedule clearly documented in the PO so Revenue Ops can book the prepayments to deferred revenue on receipt.
- Onboarding credit: $40k with 12-month expiry is fine. We should include language that credits reduce recognized revenue if consumed against services (ops to confirm exact ledger treatment).
- Marketplace ops: we can produce the private-offer JSON by EOD Nov 30, but we need procurement to confirm the exact legal entity name and billing address they will use in AWS. Also need the contact email for invoice delivery.

I'll queue legal to review the proposed forfeiture/carry-forward language — tag Kathy for any tweaks.

Monica
Head of Revenue Operations

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: Brynna Cole <brynna@finovate.ai>
Cc: Alex Hart <alex.hart@finovate.ai>, procurement@finovate.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS private offer request — draft PO + next steps

Hi Brynna — thanks for the patience. Attached are three items for your review: a draft private offer PDF (redlined-private-offer-terms.docx), the AWS private-offer JSON that marketplace ops will use to create the PO in AWS, and a short summary sheet showing the invoicing schedule and discount math.

Summary of what we will load into the AWS private offer if you sign:
- Commitment: 3yr prepaid, billed annually
- Invoice schedule: Year1 = 35% of annual committed value (discount applied to invoiced amount)
- Discounts: 22% off list Year1, 25% off list Years2-3
- Onboarding credit: $40,000 one-time credit applied to Year1 invoice, expires 12 months from effective date
- Unused prepay: 6-month carry-forward then forfeiture unless mutual extension agreed 30 days before year-end
- Excess consumption clause: overage >30% triggers incremental invoicing at list prices less agreed discount for that period

Next steps for you: 1) confirm legal entity and invoice contact details, 2) redline the draft PO if needed and return by Mon Dec 6, 3) confirm that AWS will accept the private-offer JSON payload (we usually import on your behalf but they may want the payload attached).

If procurement wants, we can also draft two alternate packaging options: (A) stronger year 1 discount in exchange for earlier minimum (45% year 1) or (B) blended all-years discount @ 24% with smaller onboarding credit. Happy to discuss tradeoffs on a call.

Best regards,
Camila Reyes
